HOW TO READ THIS ATLAS

Predictions with their context.

H04 is a saved histogram gradient boosting classifier applied with its original feature engineering. The model is frozen; these data do not retrain or recalibrate it.

Scores are class-1 model outputs, not calibrated probabilities or estimates of modification stoichiometry. A higher score should not be read as a measured fraction of modified molecules.

Coverage and comparison

Coverage is filtered per sequencing run. Qualifying run scores are averaged within each named replicate. Cell-line scores then average those replicate scores equally. Cell-line comparisons require at least two observed replicates in each group.

Sites match on transcript ID, transcript position and 7-mer sequence. Transcript coordinates are preserved as provided. Different transcript isoforms are not collapsed into unique genomic positions.

No missing value is filled with zero. Overlap statistics use the intersection of eligible sites for the selected pair; their denominators can differ between pairs.

SCOPE & PROVENANCE

What is included.

The inventory comes from the live SG-NEx m6Anet S3 directory, reconciled with the project’s sample metadata. Raw-only direct RNA samples require upstream processing and are outside this processed-data inventory.

Versioned and unversioned Ensembl transcript IDs are harmonized only when no conflicting explicit versions are observed. Original IDs are retained in downloads, and site comparisons still require matching coordinates and 7-mers. This handles versioned/unversioned naming differences without treating missing observations as negatives. Unversioned IDs still rely on the shared reference convention.

Replicate groups follow SG-NEx sample names. Technical runs are not counted as independent replicates. Experimental independence should be checked before inferential testing.

Cell-line differences can reflect expression, coverage, sequence composition, experimental batches or model transfer. This explorer makes descriptive comparisons and does not report differential-modification p-values.

H04 training provenance lists data0/data1/data2 without an accession mapping. Potential overlap with SG-NEx training-related samples is unresolved; these results are not an independent accuracy evaluation.
